description:
The concept entered broader cultural consciousness through the 2018 song " Cayetano " by Madrid indie band Carolina Durante, a satirical portrait of the archetype that catalogued its markers with dry precision. [ 3 ] The song became sufficiently popular in Spanish youth culture that it served as a pre-existing framework when TikTok users began organizing the aesthetic around 2021, producing a wave of " baja un dedo si... " (put a finger down if...) videos that codified membership in the archetype through dress, schooling, music taste, and even political alignment. [ 4 ]

The aesthetic is closely related to the older Pijo archetype, which is its masculine counterpart, and shares similarities with Preppy in the United States and Sloanie in the United Kingdom.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Simplicity, elegance, wealth, classic style, perceived elitism and conservatism

visualDNA.colour: Neutrals (beige, white, black, navy), with accents of gold

fashion.Overview: The Cayetana look is built around a principle of studied casualness: garments are basic and well-cut rather than showy, and the overall effect is one of effortless composure rather than visible effort. Silhouettes are consistently loose and unstructured, with flared or wide-leg trousers, light blouses, simple shirts, and oversized knits forming the backbone of the wardrobe. Makeup is kept minimal and natural, manicures are short and understated, and hair is worn in an unforced style. The aesthetic specifically rejects anything conspicuously fitted, heavily made-up, or visually loud. Jewelry tends toward delicate gold pieces or strings of colored beads, worn in small quantities.
